query:
UPDATE factory_review_finding f
            SET ruling = r.ruling, ruled_by = $2
            FROM UNNEST($3::int[], $4::int[], $5::text[]) AS r(seq, place, ruling)
            WHERE f.run_id = $1
              AND f.seq = r.seq
              AND f.place = r.place
              AND f.fix_status = 'disputed'
              AND f.ruling IS NULL
